description: Get query+page combinations: which exact queries are landing on which pages. Essential for detecting keyword cannibalization (multiple pages competing for the same query) and understanding the search funnel. Requires Google Search Console to be connected. Direct the user to rankparse.com/dashboard/integrations to connect it. When several Google accounts are connected, the property is read through the account that can see it.
name: get_gsc_query_page_pairs
